# Madhur The Realtor

> Independent real estate broker for land, cottages, villas and hospitality
> properties across the Kasauli hills, Himachal Pradesh.

## What we do
- Land parcels, cottages and villas for sale across Kasauli and the surrounding hills
- Buyers typically looking for a holiday home, a retirement home, a short-term rental
  investment, or a tourism/hospitality business
- Every listing personally verified (ownership papers, dated photos, confirmed price)
  before it is published
- Paid site visits: flat Rs 2,500, fully credited toward brokerage if the buyer proceeds

## Where we work
Kasauli and the surrounding hill belt, Himachal Pradesh, India: Kasauli town,
Naina Tikkar, Dochi, Jagjeet Nagar, Chabbal, Kumarhatti-Nahan Road, Barog,
Garkhal, Dharampur-Subathu Road, Kaba Kalan, Village Kanger, and
Taksal (Parwanoo).

## Buying or selling
Buyers: use the enquiry form on the site. Sellers: the site also has a
"I want to sell" option on the same form for owners looking to list a
property in the Kasauli hills area.
